versions.changelog:
Initial release of alpha-feed-creator Pro (内容采集器专业版):

- Supports multi-platform, multi-source AI content aggregation (X, Zhihu, Jike, Weibo, etc.) with batch whitelist and keyword group filters.
- Introduces advanced multi-dimensional intelligent ranking using semantic similarity, quality, and engagement metrics.
- Enables automated group/channel push, scheduled batch tasks (cron), and enterprise-level multi-tenant management.
- Compatible and upgradable from the free edition; provides custom workflow templates and detailed configuration options.
- Ideal for content teams’ daily topic selection, enterprise brand operations, and industry/competitor tracking.
